title: Store replenishment proposal with inventory and DC constraints
description: Reconcile independent synthetic stock, residual demand, inbound, route and dispatch-capacity exports into whole-case review proposals and dated shortage controls.

sample_policy.description: Invented residual-demand, lost-sales, safety, case-ceiling and DC-priority policies. No order, reservation, shipment or actual inventory update.

golden_provenance.author: Retail sector author
golden_provenance.description: All nine expected JSON files were manually enumerated from the approved research arithmetic and written policy before any baseline execution. They are not copied from baseline output and do not imply independent human or native review.
